The '''''King's Ransom''''' was a [[Treasure ship|treasury starship]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was [[Raid on the King's Ransom|robbed]] by two [[Scoundrel/Legends|thieves]] named [[Vaz Traniff]] and [[Combo]], who were aided by a [[Voidhound|smuggler]]. Among the treasures it held was the entire sum of trade between the Empire and the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The Empire contained the skull of [[Canderous Ordo]] within the vessel.
